scenes.vo: A 2-of-3 vault: you hold two keys (home + safe-deposit box); a professional co-signer holds the third under an agreed recovery process. Your letter of instruction, stored with your will, explains how your executor works with the co-signer. No single document contains enough to steal the funds.

lines: Why keep the letter of instruction apart from seeds and keys?
scenes.sub: Answer: So finding the letter isn't enough to steal the funds.

lines: What's the risk of single-key self-custody for your family?
scenes.sub: Answer: If you can't sign and no one else can, the assets are unrecoverable.
